lines: Some customers share one email address between several people, like a QC team that uses a single inbox.

Today, Salesforce blocks the second contact as a duplicate. And lead conversion can link a lead to the wrong person, because it matches on email.
Today, Salesforce blocks the second contact as a duplicate. And lead conversion can link a lead to the wrong person, because it matches on email.
So, Conscendo added a Shared Generic Email flag, on Lead and Contact.
So, Conscendo added a Shared / Generic Email flag on Lead and Contact.
When it's ticked, duplicate checks and conversion ignore the email, and match people by mobile number and name instead.

With the flag ticked, contacts on the same account can share an email, as long as their mobile or name is different.
Real duplicates are still blocked: the same mobile and the same name, on the same account.
Leads and contacts without the flag work exactly as before.
